meta.title: Sylius Starter: start in minutes, launch in days
meta.description: Sylius Starter: bootstrap a Sylius stack in minutes, launch your store in days with an expert. Open source, public repository, technical docs and a network of Sylius agencies.

hero.hook: Cut the cost of your e-commerce.
hero.titleRest: live in a matter of days.
hero.leadHtml: Sylius is ready in minutes, your full store in days. Full control over your data, zero commission on sales and an entire ecosystem to support you.

own.title: An online store that truly belongs to you.
own.intro: Many platforms host your store and charge a commission on every sale. With Sylius and its open source model, your code, theme and data are yours — all of it.
rentItems: A subscription that grows with your revenue
Data that cannot be exported off the platform
Locked in and dependent on the platform's roadmap
ownItems: A fixed price and committed timeline, agreed upfront
A budget that does not grow as your business scales
0% commission: you only pay your payment provider
Storefront, code and data: yours, exportable anytime
Swap any building block — including your agency
own.ctaLeadHtml:
It's not too late to take back control!
Recover your data and full ownership of your store.

sylius.title: Sylius Starter is built on Sylius.
sylius.introBefore: Sylius is an open source e-commerce platform built on Symfony. Thousands of developers, full customization and real sovereignty over your hosting. Sylius Starter builds on that foundation to save you time.
sylius.introLink: Learn more on the official Sylius website
sylius.shift: What Sylius Starter delivers in practice.

cards.title: Days, not months
cards.p: Your Sylius partner launches your store in days, not more. With a clear scope and controlled budget.

cards.title: MIT, your code
cards.p: MIT license, your code. No Starter lock-in: you keep Sylius, Symfony and everything else.

cards.title: Deploy anywhere
cards.p: On the server of your choice: you stay in control of your infrastructure.

cards.title: Open source and alive
cards.p: A specific need? Thousands of developers — someone will be able to help.

cards.title: No dependency
cards.p: It's your code; you can change provider whenever you want.

experts.title: Surrounded by the best.
experts.intro: Around Sylius Starter, a whole ecosystem of experts: agencies and independent developers. If you prefer to delegate, you rely on their skills to build or migrate your store. And because everything runs on an open, standard foundation, you are never tied to one team — the whole ecosystem can take over.

benefits.title: The right skills
benefits.p: A full ecosystem of Sylius specialists, rather than a single vendor and its limits.

benefits.title: Shared standards
benefits.p: Everyone works on the same proven stack, with Symfony standards the market already knows.

benefits.title: Never locked in
benefits.p: Your store belongs only to you. On an open, standard base, anyone can take over. An AI agent can help too.

stories.title: They launched with Sylius Starter.
stories.cardP: The first customer story will be published here: context, technical choices, timeline and results.

paths.title: Depending on your profile, two ways to take action.
paths.intro: Sylius Starter adapts to your context: delegate to a specialist or run it yourself — including with an AI agent.
specialistItems: Contact a Sylius agency: fast, cost-effective, scoped delivery.
Custom store in ~10 business days, fixed price agreed upfront.
Migration, support and training available for your project.
devItems: Clone the repo, run castor sylius:init: everything is ready.
Sylius Starter helps you and your AI agent. Technical documentation available.
Catalog import, plugins, deployment: all scripted and reproducible.

found.title: Sylius Starter, the experience developers were waiting for.
found.leadHtml: Sylius Starter boots a store in a single command. The last barriers fall away: launching your e-commerce takes only a few minutes. Add features when you need them, remove what you don't, adapt the back office without writing a line of code.

feats.html: A project ready in one command. Docker, Sylius, database, assets, fixtures, tests: sylius:init.
Whole features, one command. sylius:add installs, configures and migrates; sylius:remove cleans entities, migrations and dead code.
A back office in your hands. Hide or reorder menu entries without writing code.
An environment that grows with the project. Redis, Mailpit, RabbitMQ added to your project, one service at a time.

event.title: Sylius Starter at PS Summit 2026
event.p: The first open source PrestaShop & Sylius gathering: workshops, technical talks, success stories and community. Sylius Starter will be there — come meet the team and ecosystem experts.

plans.name: Custom store
plans.desc: Custom does not mean complicated. A partner expert assembles your store from proven building blocks: your theme, checkout, payment methods, shipping, search. Clear scope, fixed price, and you are selling within about ten days.

plans.name: Platform migration
plans.desc: A partner expert runs your migration: audit, replatforming, data transfer and cutover to an open stack you own. Scoped and priced for your project.

plans.name: Support & training
plans.desc: Your partner expert provides maintenance coverage and trains your team: take over the store and evolve it autonomously.
